notes: Catalogue breadboard naming puts rows a-e in bank 't'; the image shows them in the lower half, but the catalogue naming is used.
Buzzer legs are assumed to sit in column 15 (black, negative) and column 18 (purple, positive) at row e. The jumper wires start in row a of the same columns, so they share a strip with the legs.
Buzzer port mapping assumed: port 1 = positive leg (longer leg, to GPIO17), port 2 = negative leg (to GND). The catalogue does not say which is which.
Black wire goes to the ground pin next to GPIO17 on the header (the highlighted GND, physical pin 9). It is mapped to GND.1 because the GND ports are interchangeable.
The manual shows no resistor, so none is included.
